intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Ontario for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (the Historic Nativity Scenes on Euclid Avenue) through January 1, 2027, with the Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 3), the Holiday Light Parade (December 5), the Guasti Holiday Walk of Lights (December 4 to 24, with Santa on December 19), Breakfast with Santa at Rainforest Cafe (December 13, 19 and 20) and Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Ontario

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Ontario
  • 4 free events, including the Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony, the Holiday Light Parade, the Historic Nativity Scenes on Euclid Avenue and the Community Sing-Along
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at Rainforest Cafe at Ontario Mills (December 13, 19 and 20), Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's (December 19), Meet Santa at the Guasti Holiday Walk of Lights (December 19) and photos with Santa at the tree lighting and parade
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 3) and the Holiday Light Parade (December 5) on Euclid Avenue
  • Lights and singing: the Guasti Holiday Walk of Lights ($15 per vehicle, December 4 to 24), the Historic Nativity Scenes on Euclid Avenue (November 26 to January 1, 2027) and the Community Sing-Along (December 19)
  • Season: November 26 to January 1, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Ontario families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Rancho Cucamonga, which covers Victoria Gardens, Santa visits and holiday lights nearby.
